name: Truong Uyen Nhi
takenStory: Nhi watched everyone, sure that someone was lying. Now she is a tall girl of folded paper, uniform and ponytail creased into her, with no face; her watching has become a hunt, and in a flat child's voice she names each guest's lie.

name: Le Thanh
takenStory: Thanh was the bride who never sang her last act. Now she is the Opera Specter, the bride as she burned: her red dress is embers, her ribbon a line of smoke. Her courtesy remains as ceremony: she bows to each guest before she sings at them.

name: Dinh Quoc Bao
takenStory: Bao was the company's physician, calm at every bedside. Now he is the Drowned Physician: his suit drips, his glasses fog from inside, water runs from his bag. His bedside manner remains: he tells each guest calmly what they will die of.

name: Vo Minh Khang
takenStory: Khang paid for everyone's drinks and kept count of none of it. Now he is the Iron Debtor, half cast in black iron, chains grown from his gold one, fists like weights. His generosity has become bookkeeping: he tells each guest what they owe.

name: Phan Thi Mai
takenStory: Mai has kept this house longer than anyone remembers. Now she is the Rooted Caretaker, grown into the floor, soil in the folds of her clothes, keys grown into her hand. Her warmth has become a host's: she invites each guest, kindly, to stay.

name: Hoang Gia Huy
takenStory: Huy came to film the night and narrate it. Now he is the Lens: a silhouette with a lit camera lens where his chest should be, his body a beat behind its own movements. His narration goes on, describing each guest's last moments before they happen.

name: Tran Ngoc Lan
takenStory: Lan could price anything at a glance. Now she is the Silvered Reflection, her mirror self stepped out: left and right reversed, skin like silvered glass with fine cracks. She states each guest's worth, and it is always less than they hoped.
